title: Among German drivers who were born before 1985, identify the top 5 drivers
question: Among German drivers who were born before 1985, identify the top 5 drivers with the fastest average lap time across all their races. For each driver, calculate their average fastest lap time in seconds from race results. Provide their full names and average times.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  d.XCL_038,
  d.XCL_039,
  AVG(
    CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN results AS r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) < '1985'
  AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
ORDER BY avg_fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 5
